integrity: The mathematical assertions are accompanied by a self-contained proof and deterministic diagnostic tests. Independent audit and exhaustive historical-priority verification were not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional forward Gaussian KL and trace-preserving isotropic surrogate only.
Sharp over the full SPD condition-number class; may not be attained by a fixed Lanczos construction.
No theorem for reverse KL, non-Gaussian laws, sampling error, or solver convergence.
title: Sharp condition-number KL risk for trace-preserving isotropic Gaussian covariance approximations
